answer: Divergent-Challenge Attestation. Each identity must answer fresh, unseen challenge instances whose answers depend on its own past outputs; a clone sharing the same history answers identically, so any challenge that forces divergence exposes it. Answers are checked against a basalt-committed transcript of prior responses, and a failed divergence test collapses the clone's standing. To pass, an attacker must maintain a separate genuine history per identity, paying full compute and storage at every summit of the challenge sequence, with no ripple of shared state allowed between clones.
